highlights.title: Tresses et nattes
highlights.desc: Knotless, box braids, nattes collées et vanilles : des tresses légères, régulières, posées sans tirer.

highlights.desc: Création, reprise et entretien de locs, avec un soin du cuir chevelu à chaque visite.

highlights.desc: Soins profonds, protéines, coloration douce : des cheveux nourris avant toute coiffure.

pillars.label: Douceur

about.desc: Awa opened the salon in 2018 with one chair and one rule: never rush a client. Eight years later the team has three stylists and the rule has not changed. Every appointment starts with a conversation about your hair, your routine and the result you want.

pillars.label: Listening
pillars.text: We take the time to understand what you want before touching your hair.

pillars.label: Precision
pillars.text: Clean parts, even braids, a result that lasts.

pillars.label: Gentleness
pillars.text: No excessive tension: your edges and scalp are protected.

faq.q: Should I come with washed hair?
faq.a: Yes, washed and detangled the day before or the same day. A shampoo is available on site if needed.
Extensions are included in the price of knotless and box braids. For other services, bring your own or ask us.
A 20% deposit confirms your appointment. It is deducted from the total on the day.
